body.name: four-node profile-collision path
body.construction: For \(d=4\), \(r=2\), and \(E=2\), take \(a=(1,1,2,1)^{\mathsf T}\), \(b=(0,1,1,2)^{\mathsf T}\), \(Q=aa^{\mathsf T}+bb^{\mathsf T}\), and \(\Delta_2(\gamma)=2aa^{\mathsf T}+(2+\gamma)bb^{\mathsf T}\), with the fixed positive-definite baseline given by the positive-noise completion.
